title: AuthResponse
description: Authentication response notified by the station to the app on BLE characteristic FFF4. Inside the channel it answers the OfflineAuthRequest or ServerSignedAuth; in plaintext, instead of a Challenge, it refuses a Hello before any key exists (profiles/offline/ble-handshake.md §5). A refusal carries the one BLE error shape: errorCode, errorText and optional details (07-errors.md §2.3).

sessionKeyConfirmation.description: Base64-encoded HMAC-SHA256(sessionKey, "AuthResponse_OK") (exactly 44 chars), present when result is Accepted (06-security.md §6.5).

durationSeconds.description: Advisory copy of the authorized service duration for app UX (finding N3). UNSIGNED - relayed by the station from the SIGNED ServerSignedAuth claims (Partial A) or the AuthorizeOfflinePass response (Partial B), or, for a pass the station validated itself, the duration the OfflineAuthRequest requested. The station checks a StartServiceRequest against the SIGNED durationSeconds or the AuthorizeOfflinePass response value, NOT this advisory field, and refuses a longer request (profiles/offline/ble-session.md §1). MAY be present when result is Accepted.

creditsAuthorized.description: Advisory copy of the authorized credit budget for app UX (finding N3). UNSIGNED - see durationSeconds. MAY be present when result is Accepted.

errorCode.description: The registry code of the refusal (07-errors.md §4.3). Present when result is Rejected.

errorText.description: The registry name of errorCode, in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (07-errors.md §1.3). Present when result is Rejected.

details.description: Per-occurrence context of the refusal (07-errors.md §2.3). With 4002 OFFLINE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED it carries constraint: the pass field or the station configuration key whose limit refused (offline-pass.md §2.2). MAY be present when result is Rejected.
